item.title: Iceland: status of crypto-asset providers under MiCA
item.summary: Since 1 July 2026, only firms licensed as crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) under Act No. 101/2025 on markets in crypto-assets may provide crypto-asset services in Iceland, the Central Bank of Iceland (Seðlabanki Íslands) said. The act took effect on 1 January 2026 and implements the EU's MiCA regulation (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114). Providers registered under the anti-money-laundering act No. 140/2018 had a transition period until 1 July 2026 to obtain a licence. According to the Central Bank, the companies that provided crypto-asset services on the basis of that registration but did not hold a CASP licence under MiCA on 1 July 2026 are IsMynt ehf., Orange Gateway ehf., Rafmyntasjóður Íslands ehf. and Monerium hf. (listed by ESMA as Monerium ehf).
